rows.a: the break leaves only an inner switch: int a(int k) { while (true) { switch (k) { case 0: break; } if (k > 3) return k; } }
rows.b: a goto leaves the loop: int b(int k) { while (true) { if (k) goto out; } out:; }
rows.c: the break leaves only an inner for: int c(int k) { while (true) { for (;;) { if (k) break; } if (k > 3) return k; } }
rows.d control: a break leaves the loop: int d(int k) { while (true) { if (k) break; } }
rows.e: a goto to a label inside the loop bod: int e(int k) { while (true) { if (k) goto next; ++k; next:; if (k > 3) return k; } }
rows.f: for (;;) with a goto that leaves it: int f(int k) { for (;;) { if (k) goto out; } out:; }
rows.g: do while (true) with a break in an in: int g(int k) { do { while (k) { break; } if (k > 3) return k; } while (true); }
rows.h control: a loop with constant true and: int h(int k) { while (true) { if (k > 3) return k; ++k; } }
